caption: GONZALEZ-LONGORIA, GREGORIO V. UNITED STATES
text: The petition for rehearing is granted. The order entered May 14, 2018, denying the petition for a writ of certiorari is vacated. The motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and the petition for a writ of certiorari are granted.
